newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Offers mostly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Offers mostly steady to lower.

text.p: U.S. rail and truck soymeal basis offers were mostly steady to weaker on Monday, dragged down by slack demand, dealers said.

"We are coming to the end of the summer downtimes," one Midwest broker said. "Thus, the basis then will start to weaken because no one has bought anything forward and when these plants come up again, they appear not to have any sales up front. Everything was bought hand to mouth."
Several dealers also said that the Archer Daniels Midland, Decatur, Ill., plant is expected to take downtime starting Monday night this week and restart on Friday.
ADM did not immediately return a call for confirmation but one industry source said, "That is fair to say that is a tentative schedule."
A different company's plant in Minnesota is also taking downtime this week, the broker added.
